Comunidad.title: A journey that transcends borders
Comunidad.ar_desc: In Buenos Aires the Jewgal method was born and the first Life Coaching processes began. She formed the first well-being communities and laid the foundations of her integrative philosophy that today reaches the whole world.
Comunidad.il_desc: In Jerusalem and Tel Aviv she deepened her studies of applied Kabbalah and Jewish thought, integrating this ancient wisdom as a tool for coaching and conscious personal transformation.
Comunidad.co_desc: From Bogotá and Medellín she trained hundreds of certified Jewgal instructors and Life Coaches. Colombia became the heart of her Latin American network of well-being and transformation.
Comunidad.us_desc: From Miami she leads online programs with global reach, founded the 501c3 organization Sholem Corazón Valiente, and created Jewgal Academy to support the transformation of students around the world.

Devora.heroSubtext: Over 40 years facilitating transformation processes that integrate mind, body, and soul, with international experience across Argentina, Israel, Guatemala, Colombia, and the United States.
Devora.stat3: Countries: Argentina · Israel · Guatemala · Colombia · USA
Devora.bioP1: I am Devora Benchimol. International Master Coach, educator, Rabbanit, and founder of Jewgal Academy.
Devora.bioP2: For over 40 years I have accompanied people in Argentina, Israel, Guatemala, Colombia, and the United States through their deepest processes — the ones felt in the body, the ones that ache in the soul, and the ones that transform life forever.
Devora.bioQuote1: My path wasn't born in a classroom. It was born from real encounters with human beings.
Devora.bioP3: From that journey emerged a way of working that integrates what most keep separate: mind and body, technique and intuition, academic knowledge and ancestral wisdom.
Devora.bioP4: I am the creator of Joogalkids, a Mindfulness in Motion program based on the Alef Bet, designed for children to learn to connect with their inner world through movement, play, and the wisdom of the Hebrew letters. And of Jewgal, its version for adults — my own methodology that brings that same principle of consciousness in motion to those who guide, teach, and lead.
Devora.bioListIntro: To every retreat I bring all of that:
Devora.bioItem1: The depth of Logotherapy to find meaning where there seems to be none.
Devora.bioItem2: The presence of Mindfulness and trauma work to heal from within.
Devora.bioItem3: The wisdom of Kabbalah as a map of the soul and a tool for real transformation.
Devora.bioItem4: The language of the body through Body Expression, Dance, and Therapeutic Massage.
Devora.bioItem5: The delicacy of Bach Flowers and Tapping to release what words cannot reach.
Devora.bioItem6: And the lens of conscious education so that every process is also a learning that integrates and endures.
Devora.bioQuote2Line1: I don't come to give you answers.
Devora.bioQuote2Line2: I come to accompany you in finding your own.
Devora.coachSubtext: A space for individual support — you and Devora, working on your particular process. It's not a course or a certification: it's time dedicated entirely to your transformation.
Devora.docSubtext: Watch the documentary Sholem Soul Goal — a true story about identity, belonging, and the value of being authentic.
Devora.missionQuote: "To facilitate transformation processes that integrate mind, body, and soul, helping each person reach their full potential and personal leadership."
Devora.tray1Event: Beginnings in Buenos Aires. First steps in human development, well-being, and holistic support.
Devora.tray2Event: Immersion in Kabbalah and Jewish spirituality applied to personal development.
Devora.tray3Event: Guiding transformation processes and training leaders in Central America.
Devora.tray4Event: Expansion of the Jewgal method and coach training across Latin America.
Devora.tray5Event: Miami · International headquarters. From Miami she leads online programs with global reach, founded the 501c3 organization Sholem Corazón Valiente, and created Jewgal Academy to transform lives.
Devora.fundP1: Founded by Devora Benchimol, CEO and creator. A non-profit organization committed to inspiring, empowering, and training leaders with a brave heart, dedicated to transforming the world from Jewish values and love.
Devora.fundP2: Through educational programs, retreats, and trainings, we accompany people of all ages to discover their purpose and build more compassionate and conscious communities.
Devora.ctaSubtext: Choose the program that best fits your path and start this week.
